visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A small plastic mascot figure with a blue body and a ring of red bubbles featuring eyes (Myaku-Myaku) is positioned on a flat white surface. Bright studio lighting illuminates the scene, casting soft shadows. Yellow sparkle icons appear briefly. (2) A pair of human hands enters the frame, holding an articulated S.H.Figuarts version of the same mascot. The hands manipulate the limbs, demonstrating flexibility in the blue plastic arms and legs against a background showing a product box. (3) The hands perform a close-up demonstration of swapping parts, replacing a blue mouth-like piece on the mascot's torso and adjusting its tail. The background remains a cluttered but brightly lit workspace with retail packaging. (4) A larger, soft-vinyl version of the mascot is displayed; it is a piggy bank. A hand picks it up, showing its scale and the coin slot on its back. The background shifts to a blurry retail environment. (5) The scene transitions to a brightly lit Japanese train station or mall interior with 'Welcome' signs in multiple languages. Shoppers in casual clothing walk past information boards for the EXPO 2025 Official Store. (6) Various store interiors are shown, featuring shelves densely packed with merchandise including plush toys, mugs, and Sanrio character collaboration items under warm, commercial lighting. (7) A final shot displays a row of blue and red plushies sitting on a white shelf under a large 'OFFICIAL STORE' sign. The camera is static, focusing on the mascot's distinctive multi-eyed design.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video serves as a promotional shopping guide for merchandise related to the Osaka EXPO 2025. It uses a high-energy montage to showcase the features of a specific articulated mascot toy before providing practical information on store locations and the variety of products available, aiming to drive tourism and merchandise sales.
